Since \(f\) has period 2, \(f(\sqrt{10})=f(\sqrt{10}-2)\). Apply the period again: \(f(\sqrt{10}-2)=f(\sqrt{10}-4)\). Now \(\sqrt{10}-4=-(4-\sqrt{10})\), so by oddness,
\[ f(\sqrt{10}-4)=f(-(4-\sqrt{10}))=-f(4-\sqrt{10}). \]
Because \(4-\sqrt{10}\in(0,1)\), use the given formula:
\[ f(4-\sqrt{10})=(4-\sqrt{10})^2-8(4-\sqrt{10})+30. \]
Expand: \((4-\sqrt{10})^2=16-8\sqrt{10}+10\), and \(-8(4-\sqrt{10})=-32+8\sqrt{10}\). Therefore
\[ f(4-\sqrt{10})=(16-8\sqrt{10}+10)-32+8\sqrt{10}+30=24. \]
Thus \(f(\sqrt{10})=-24\), so the answer is \(\boxed{-24}\).
